                _, c_dev, c_ino, _, c_nlink = get_node_info(r.name) # This is not quite right
                if c_nlink > 1:

                        continue
                    seen_at_root[(c_dev, c_ino)] = True

            r.parent = root
            r.depth = 1
            root.children.append(r)

            n, d = stack.pop()
            n.depth = d
            for c in n.children:

def json_to_node(data):
    node = Node(data["name"], data["size"], data["children"] != [])
    for c_data in data["children"]:
        child = json_to_node(c_data)
        child.parent = node
        node.children.append(child)
    # Recalculate depths
    stack = [(node, 0)]
    while stack:
        n, d = stack.pop()
        n.depth = d
        for c in n.children:
            stack.append((c, d + 1))
    return node

def filter_and_sort(node, max_depth, min_ratio, total_root_size, no_sort):
    if node.depth >= max_depth:
        node.children = []
        return
    
    new_children = []
    for c in node.children:
        if total_root_size > 0 and (c.size / total_root_size) < min_ratio:
            continue
        filter_and_sort(c, max_depth, min_ratio, total_root_size, no_sort)
        new_children.append(c)
    
    if not no_sort:
        new_children.sort(key=lambda x: (-x.size, x.name))
    node.children = new_children

def get_tree_lines(node, prefixes, is_last, top_down):
    if node.parent is None:
        conn = "└─┬" if node.children else "└──"
    else:
        char = "└" if is_last else "├"
        branch = "─┬" if node.children else "──"
        conn = char + branch
    
    line_prefix = "".join(prefixes)
    line = {
        'size': node.size,
        'name': node.name,
        'conn': conn,
        'prefix': line_prefix,
        'depth': node.depth,
        'children': node.children,
        'parent': node.parent,
        'ancestors': []
    }
    
    # Store ancestor sizes for bars
    curr = node.parent
    while curr:
        line['ancestors'].append(curr.size)
        curr = curr.parent
    line['ancestors'].reverse() # root, level 1, level 2, ...
    
    res = [line]
    for i, c in enumerate(node.children):
        new_prefixes = prefixes + ("  ",) if is_last else prefixes + ("│ ",)
        res.extend(get_tree_lines(c, new_prefixes, i == len(node.children) - 1, top_down))
    return res
